summary.oneLiner: Dredging Corporation of India Limited is a leading player in the Indian dredging industry, with a strong order book and support from its promoter ports, but faces challenges from ageing fleet and foreign exchange risk.

one-line thesis: Dredging Corporation of India Limited is a leading player in the Indian dredging industry, with a strong order book and support from its promoter ports, but faces challenges from ageing fleet and foreign exchange risk.
financial scorecard / credit view: Revenue: 1,142 crore (FY25); EBITDA: 140 crore (FY25); PAT: -27 crore (FY25); Net Debt: 342 crore (as on Feb 28, 2026); Credit Rating: CARE BBB+; Stable (as on April 8, 2026)
guidance / outlook: Outlook: Stable; Strategy: Focus on maintaining strong order book, improving profitability, and reducing debt
segment / subsidiary detail: Dredging: 83% of order book; Marine Construction: 17% of order book
growth verticals / optionality: Commissioning of new dredger, DCI Dredge Godavari, expected to enhance capacity and support growth
margins & cost dynamics: PBILDT Margin: 12.23% (FY25); Fuel costs: high due to geopolitical developments
capex / expansion: Term loan of 400 crore from Sagarmala Finance Corporation Limited for dry docking and major maintenance
capital allocation: Promoter support: 342 crore of unsecured loans; Debt financing: 400 crore term loan
risks & watch-items: Ageing fleet; Foreign exchange risk; Competition from foreign players
non-obvious takeaways: Support from promoter ports; Commissioning of new dredger

themes.title: Naval shipbuilding & maritime
themes.need: A multi-decade naval order book and indigenous warship/submarine build, plus the naval-equipment supply chain (HVAC/chillers, mechanical seals, marine gearing) and maritime services, underpin the theme. GRSE carries a large RFP pipeline (~INR1.5 lakh cr referenced); SHREE REFRIGERATIONS 544458 supplies naval HVAC; SEALMATIC 543782 naval/submarine seals; ELECON defence-marine gearing; KMEW/SEAMECLTD/DREDGECORP maritime services.
themes.driver: Fresh MoD warship/submarine orders + naval-equipment indigenization inflow; maritime-infra/offshore contract wins.

themes.title: Maritime shipping & terminalling
themes.need: Shipping and liquid/gas terminalling players are driven by freight/charter cycles, terminalling tariffs and energy-cargo throughput - not the e-comm/quick-comm/GST-warehousing formalization powering the parcel & 3PL up-cycle.
themes.driver: Freight/charter rates, terminalling tariffs and energy-cargo throughput.
